ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence must be completed before incorporation. Every shareholder, director, authorized signatory, and 25% or greater UBO must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT sanctions list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Interpol red notices (where available), and the VFSC enforcement/ineligibility list. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence requiring source of wealth, source of funds, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Registered agents are required to file a beneficial ownership statement to VFSC and to update it whenever there is any change in indirect or direct ownership, under the Beneficial Ownership (Company) Act 2018.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry — electronic filing through VFSC-licensed registered agents only; no direct public incorporation filing is permitted
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The name must be expressed in English or French, or in Bislama using Latin script. Non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Japanese) must be transliterated into a Latin-script version for registration. The name must end with a recognized suffix: Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Société Anonyme, or the abbreviations Ltd., Corp., Inc., or S.A. No local Bislama-only naming requirement applies.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words implying banking or deposit-taking activity: Bank, Banking, Finance, Investment, Savings, Deposit
Insurance-related words: Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Underwriter
Trust and corporate-services words: Trust, Trustee, Trust Company
Words implying connection with the Republic of Vanuatu or state organs: Government, President, Ministry, Department, Parliament, Republic of Vanuatu, National
Other sensitive/misleading tokens: University, Chartered, Cooperative, Guarantee, Fidelity, Chamber of Commerce
Any name identical or deceptively similar to an existing company registered in the VFSC registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the licensed registered agent may, within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, file a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Registry Manager, attaching the refusal letter, company search results, any third-party consent, and legal grounds. VFSC must respond in writing within 30 days with an approval, conditional approval, or final refusal. Name reservations are not extendable; once expired, a new name reservation application must be filed. If administrative reconsideration fails, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 45 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office without a Vanuatu physical presence is not permitted. Every International Company must have a physical registered office located in Vanuatu, provided by a VFSC-licensed registered agent. For the target business scope — offshore handmade PVC/epoxy resin polyhedral dice casting sold via Kickstarter, Stripe, and PayPal — a virtual office is permissible for back-office, marketing, and payment administration, provided the statutory registered agent and registered office in Port Vila are maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. For a non-regulated, low-risk manufacturing and online-sales International Company, the realistic annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection is under 5%. The probability rises materially if the entity conducts regulated financial activity, becomes a payment aggregator, or generates AML/CFT red flags such as high-risk payment patterns, sanctions hits, or PEP involvement.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222], as amended, especially ss. 4 (incorporation), 8 (memorandum and articles), 12 (registered office and registered agent), 19-23 (share capital), and 25-26 (directors and secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Corporate Affairs Registry / International Company Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with Application for Incorporation and Registered Agent Consent, resulting in a Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up or escrowed capital. At least one issued share is required; shares may be with or without par value and may be denominated in any currency as stipulated in the memorandum.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. That the subscribers to the Memorandum approve the allotment and issue of the initial subscriber shares, on receipt of payment, and that the consideration be credited in the company's books. 2. That the registered office of the Company be fixed at the office of the Registered Agent, [Registered Agent Address], Port Vila, Vanuatu. 3. That the registered agent be appointed to maintain the statutory register. 4. That [Director Name] be appointed director, [Secretary Name] be appointed secretary, and [President Name] be appointed president of the Company, each until removed. 5. That the officers be authorized to execute the bank account opening forms and regulatory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Affairs Registry, Online Naming Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name, together with a reserved-name request, through the VFSC online portal or via a licensed registered agent. Confirm that the name is not identical or deceptively similar to any existing Vanuatu International Company and does not contain restricted words.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, submit a revised name reservation through the registered agent within 2 business days; VFSC will process the resubmission in priority order.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Prepare Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent and provide corporate due diligence information. The agent will draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered office consent, and first director consent forms, ensuring compliance with International Companies Act requirements.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of each subscriber/beneficial owner
Proof of residential address for each subscriber/beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent or VFSC identifies incomplete due diligence, the subscriber shall provide corrected documents within 5 business days; the agent will resubmit the draft instrument upon clearing the deficiency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Affairs Registry, International Companies Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum and Articles, together with the prescribed application form and statutory declarations, through the registered agent. Pay the official state filing fee by approved electronic transfer or card. The registered agent submits the complete package to VFSC and acknowledges receipt in the IC Registry system.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office and registered agent consent
Proof of payment of filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query or rejection memo, the registered agent shall file an amendment or supplemental declaration within 7 days; the filing fee is preserved and no duplicate fee is charged for correcting clerical errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After VFSC approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and registers the company in the International Company Register. The registered agent collects the certificate and prepares the final corporate kit containing the certificate, memorandum, articles, and corporate seals.
required_dossiers: Receipt of official state filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains any typographical or legal defect, the registered agent may apply for rectification under the International Companies Act; VFSC will issue a corrected certificate within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt First Board Resolutions and Execute Post-Incorporation Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board of Directors, supervised by the VFSC Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting in writing or by unanimous resolution. Ratify the allotment of subscriber shares, adopt the registered office and registered agent, and appoint the initial officers. Execute share certificates, statutory registers, board minutes, and banking resolutions.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a document is rejected by a bank or external party, the board may sign a corrected resolution; the registered agent will file a notice of resolution or amendment with VFSC if the correction changes statutory records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register Operational and Manufacturing Attributes with Authorized Agencies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, and Municipal Business Licence Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If physical manufacturing premises are established, apply for the relevant business licence, foreign investment registration if applicable, and a Taxpayer Identification Number for administrative purposes. Submit the environmental compliance notification to the Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation.
required_dossiers: Fire safety clearance from Vanuatu Fire Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an agency requests further information, submit an amended application through the one-stop shop or registered agent within 10 business days; approvals already granted remain valid pending clarification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Business Licence and, where foreign-owned, Foreign Investment Registration Certificate

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Initial Environmental Examination / EIA Registration; full Environmental Impact Assessment report is not required for small-scale tabletop dice casting with resin volume below the statutory trigger threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No untreated liquid resin, epoxy sludge, or solvent-bearing wastewater may be discharged to land, stormwater, or surface water. Ventilation must control airborne VOC concentrations to the occupational exposure limits adopted by the Department of Labour; off-spec resin and solid waste must be stored in sealed containers and removed by a DEPC-approved waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from Vanuatu Fire Services, building load certificate from the Public Works Department where casting benches and storage shelving are installed, and occupational health and safety clearance from the Department of Labour, including chemical SDS availability, PPE provision, and emergency eyewash facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), a department of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management of the Republic of Vanuatu; official portal: https://vrc.gov.vu (VAT administration, customs single-window, and taxpayer services). Corporate registry counter-party: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 — Incorporation: the foreign beneficial owner instructs a VFSC-licensed registered agent to incorporate the International Company under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and an IC registration number, which is the entity’s statutory corporate ID; no minimum capital is required and 100% non-resident ownership is permitted. Step 2 — Tax ID / VAT registration: there is no effective income-tax TIN regime in Vanuatu, so the IC is not issued a general tax ID unless it registers for VAT; export-only manufacturers should voluntarily register for VAT under s.38(5) of the VAT Act [CAP 248] to recover input VAT on resins, moulds and packaging; if the IC makes local taxable supplies in Vanuatu above the statutory threshold, mandatory registration is due within 21 days after the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded (application: VRC VAT Form 1, accompanied by Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent’s certificate, registered office address, expected turnover and bank details; the VRC issues a VAT certificate and VAT number in the format VAT-XXXX). Step 3 — Customs: the IC obtains an exporter code from the Vanuatu Customs Service division of the VRC for lodging export entries. Constraint: an IC is restricted by s.3(2) of the IC Act [CAP 222] from carrying on domestic business in Vanuatu; export-only sales to non-residents, or contracting with third-country toll manufacturers, are the compliant archetypes; any physical manufacturing footprint inside Vanuatu should be ring-fenced in a separately incorporated domestic subsidiary (also zero-income-tax, but VAT- and customs-exposed).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt, under ss.49-50 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and the absence of any effective income tax law, from income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, inheritance tax and stamp duty on all profits and gains derived within or outside Vanuatu; it is treated as non-resident for direct-tax purposes, and neither pass-through nor entity-level taxation applies. The only operative national tax is Value Added Tax (12.5%) on a territorial supply basis: local taxable supplies attract VAT, goods exported from Vanuatu are zero-rated, and no VAT burden arises on export revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime because no corporate income tax is in operation. Statutory elections available to the IC: (1) voluntary VAT registration under s.38(5) VAT Act [CAP 248] for input-VAT recovery on export inputs, subject to a minimum registration period and quarterly refund filings; (2) migration/continuation election under the IC Act [CAP 222] to redomicile the company to, or from, another jurisdiction without winding-up; (3) conversion election into a domestic company under the Companies Act [CAP 191], which forfeits IC status and the s.3(2) local-business restriction but creates no direct-tax disadvantage because domestic companies are equally free of income tax; (4) no OECD-global-minimum-tax election is currently exercisable in Vanuatu, as no qualifying income-tax law and no IIR/UTPR mechanism is yet in force.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 248], administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 4,000,000 (approximately USD 33,000) of taxable supplies in Vanuatu in any rolling 12-month period (VAT Act [CAP 248] s.38; confirm current VRC guidance for a possible uplift under the VAT (Amendment) Act 2022). Nexus is territorial: VAT applies where goods are produced, delivered or made available in Vanuatu or where services are physically performed in Vanuatu, regardless of the supplier’s place of incorporation. A foreign IC selling goods that are manufactured, stored and delivered from Vanuatu to overseas buyers is within the zero-rating regime rather than the local taxable regime, whereas any sale of goods delivered within Vanuatu counts toward the threshold; export-only sellers may register voluntarily to claim input-VAT refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not mandated. Vanuatu has no real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control (CTC), e-invoicing clearance, or digital stamping system for ISIC 3240 manufactured goods as of the dossier effective date. Taxpayers must issue and retain VAT invoices in standard VRC format (paper or PDF) with sequential numbering, supplier and buyer names, VAT number, and VAT-exclusive/inclusive amounts; export consignments must be covered by the customs export declaration. The VRC operates a digital portal for VAT return filing and payment (monthly or quarterly), but invoice clearance remains post-audit rather than real-time. Payment-rail evidence (Stripe, PayPal, bank remittance) is accepted as corroborating export documentation when mapped to invoice numbers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under s.6(2) and the First Schedule of the VAT Act [CAP 248] to (a) consideration for goods physically exported from Vanuatu by the supplier within 30 days of the tax invoice, and (b) services supplied to a non-resident where the service relates to goods to be exported and is consumed wholly outside Vanuatu. For ISIC 3240 epoxy-resin role-play dice: the IC must export finished goods via a Vanuatu port or airport (Port Vila or Santo) under a named foreign buyer’s order; title and risk must pass to the buyer at the FOB export point; samples, replacements and warranty items count as supplies and must be supported by the same export trail; a PO Box delivery or an invoice without physical export is outside zero-rating and is taxable at 12.5%. Exported goods also qualify for input-VAT refunds on resins, moulds and packaging purchased in Vanuatu, but the refund claim must be lodged with the quarterly VAT return and accompanied by the full documentation bundle.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Original Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs Single Administrative Document) endorsed with the clearance stamp and exporter code of the VU_IC
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical dispatch from a Vanuatu port or airport to the overseas buyer’s destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Vanuatu bank, or payment-gateway payout statement (Stripe/PayPal) matched at invoice level, evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Commercial invoice and packing list cross-referencing the customs export declaration (HS Code 9504.90 / toy-and-game classification per ISIC 3240 alignment)
Signed export contract or purchase order from the non-resident buyer, plus the VRC VAT export schedule (Form VRC-VAT-EX) where a refund is claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit zero-rating claims within the 3-year assessment window (s.72 VAT Act [CAP 248]). If the exporter fails to produce the documentation bundle, or the foreign-exchange proceeds are not traceable within 180 days of the invoice date, the zero-rated output is recharacterised as taxable at 12.5% with interest at 1.5% per month (18% per annum) under s.70, and a clawback assessment is issued for the full unrecovered input-VAT credits. Fraudulent or reckless export declarations attract s.69 penalties of 200% of the tax evaded and/or imprisonment up to 2 years; false customs entries additionally engage the Customs Act [CAP 245] s.255 with fines up to VT 1,000,000 and forfeiture of the goods. For crowdfunding and card payments (Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal), aggregate platform payouts without per-invoice remittance mapping are treated as unsubstantiated and are scrutinised as potential disguised tax evasion; exporters must maintain platform settlement reports, chargeback logs, and invoice-level reconciliation for audit defence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 190] and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 225].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted Article VIII obligations of the IMF Articles of Agreement, thereby ensuring unrestricted current account convertibility and free transfer of payments for current international transactions. Capital account flows are administratively exempt for non-resident International Companies, which are treated as external to the domestic Vatu economy. There are no statutory restrictions on maintaining and settling foreign currency accounts, and no withholding tax or income tax is imposed on profit remittances by an International Company to non-residents. The only practical hurdles arise from bank-side AML/KYC due diligence and the need to demonstrate beneficial ownership and source of funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender requirement applies to a Vanuatu International Company. Where goods are physically exported from the Republic of Vanuatu, a licensed trading entity resident in Vanuatu must repatriate proceeds within 180 days from the date of shipment, unless the RBV grants a longer period. An International Company operating purely as a foreign-trading entity outside the domestic customs and exchange-control perimeter is exempt from mandatory conversion of foreign-currency receipts, provided it does not transact in Vatu with domestic residents. The company should maintain non-resident status by keeping all operational accounts in currencies other than the Vatu and by recording export invoices in USD or another external currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Currency Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Ltd

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Currency Current Account and Forward FX Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Mainstream multi-currency electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise, Airwallex and Payoneer generally accept Vanuatu-registered companies only as payment-disbursement beneficiaries, not as full banking clients. Legal constraints include EMI policy restrictions on FATF/EU-list or under-defined jurisdictions, insistence on a physical rep office in a recognized PSD2 jurisdiction, and the requirement for the underlying corporation to provide audited financial statements for the last two years. The most effective substitute is to route shelf payments through Stripe's Hong Kong or Singapore entity, or through PayPal's US account with a verified business KYC, while retaining an ANZ Port Vila account for treasury concentration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance by directors in Port Vila is not a statutory requirement, but the RBV-licensed bank's compliance committee must approve a remote opening exception. Remote opening is permitted subject to: (a) notarized certified true copies of passports and proof of residential address; (b) board resolution under company seal approving account signatories; (c) pre-recorded video interview of each shareholder/director, including a live time-stamped declaration; and (d) reference letters from the existing primary banking institution of each beneficial owner. A fully paperless opening is not accepted for International Companies due to their non-regulated status; a registered agent's covering letter is always required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered office is a standard agent mailbox with no economic substance in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified lease or sub-lease of commercial office space in Port Vila, utility invoice in company name, local secretary engagement contract, and a board resolution confirming treasury and procurement functions are administered from the leased premises.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound settlements from crowdfunding platforms (Kickstarter/Stripe) form a high volume of small-value consumer transfers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Project listing contract, Stripe merchant settlement statements with cumulative volumes, PayPal invoice archive, anonymized donor/customer summary, and a written 'know-your-crowdfunding' policy describing product delivery milestones.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid onward disbursement to third-party dice manufacturers in China or Hong Kong may indicate trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercially signed purchase orders, HS Code 9504.90 invoice declarations, bill of lading or air waybill numbers, matching packing lists, and MT103 copies referencing purpose code 3300 (payment for imported goods).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No payroll, fixed operating costs, or office overhead indicates a shell or front company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Employment agreement for the local operations manager, monthly accounting journal from a Port Vila certified accountant, invoices for cloud IT services, paid registered-agent fees, and board meeting minutes documenting operational decisions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions should be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's personal or corporate account to the ANZ/BSP foreign-currency escrow account. The SWIFT field 70 must contain the clear remittance purpose 'Capital Subscription—Issue of Shares' and field 50 should match the name on the passport. A share subscription agreement and board resolution must be pre-delivered to the bank's compliance officer. RBV exchange-control notification (Form EC/1) is required only if the injection is denominated in or converted into Vatu; for USD/GBP/EUR no approval is needed. Sums above USD 100,000 trigger a source-of-funds questionnaire and the bank may request a blockchain or card-settlement trail for the funds' provenance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier invoices for epoxy resin, molding silicone, pigments, and polyhedral-dice packaging materials are settled via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code '2230' (imports of goods) or the domestic equivalent '2000', accompanied by the pro-forma invoice and purchase order. For larger purchases from high-risk regions, an irrevocable at-sight commercial letter of credit (MT700) may be issued through ANZ Port Vila against presentation of transport documents and certificate of origin. Legacy procurement for warehousing in Port Vila may be made via domestic Vatu clearing using a National Bank account, but such transactions must not exceed 10% of monthly revenue in order to preserve the International Company's non-resident tax and exchange-control status.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward FX contract (up to 12 months) executed with ANZ or BRED Vanuatu against USD/VUV, provided the underlying exposure is an identifiable trade flow from dice exports or inventory purchases.
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) in VUV/USD transacted through an offshore prime broker, because VUV is not widely deliverable beyond the Pacific region.

Cross-currency interest rate swap (CCIRS) negotiated with the local commercial bank or an international bank where the International Company holds an intra-group borrowing facility denominated in EUR or USD.

FX option collar (zero-cost collar) to cap conversion cost of projected Kickstarter receipts from multiple consumer currencies into USD, with the bank acting as counterparty and margin posted in a segregated escrow account.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 2 calendar months following the anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 50,000 (approx. USD 420); further failure beyond 3 months after the anniversary may result in administrative strike-off and dissolution by VFSC without further notice

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for Vanuatu International Companies; no financial statements need be filed with VFSC, and no public disclosure of accounts is mandated unless the company voluntarily chooses to undertake an audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) may be adopted voluntarily; Vanuatu does not mandate a specific statutory accounting framework for International Companies retained records

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public beneficial ownership register filing is required on an annual basis for a Vanuatu International Company; however, the registered agent must maintain a current beneficial ownership file at all times and any change in shareholding or beneficial ownership is to be recorded in the company's internal records within a reasonable period. The annual return must confirm the registered shareholders and directors but is not a public UBO declaration.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; if voluntarily prepared, USD 1,500 - USD 3,000 per audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, turnover tax, or payroll tax. International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes under the International Companies Act (Cap 222). The only recurring public dues are flat annual registry fees payable to the VFSC. Under the Value Added Tax Act No. 21 of 2024 (in force 1 July 2025, standard rate 15%), goods manufactured and exported, such as dice sets shipped to Kickstarter backers, are zero-rated, so an export-only IC bears no net indirect tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No CIT return. Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, so no income tax return is filed; the IC instead files annual regulatory returns with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable (no CIT filing cycle exists).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that no corporate income tax return or payment obligation arises for a Vanuatu International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders receive no Vanuatu CIT assessment; any foreign tax credit claim rests on the IC's VFSC tax-exemption certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No late CIT penalty applies. Fabricating documents to evidence a Vanuatu income tax burden in a foreign jurisdiction may be prosecuted as fraud.
